what: The recorded RTX 5090 sample vectors of autoproof PROBE-3 (nvfp4: e2m1 codes as one hex nibble each, ue4m3 scale bytes as hex, one scale per 16 codes; ascending-K chain from acc=0; silicon word as hex) and PROBE-2 (unscaled e2m1 through mma.sync m16n8k32 kind::f8f6f4, no scales). Replayed by packages/verity/tests/ml/test_models.py.

provenance.model2_under_test: Gdfs2Config { w1: 42, w2: 36, stage2_kind: PerAddendAccAnchor, dir1: Zero, dir2: Zero, stage1_post_add: false, stage2_post_add: true, stage2_anchor_actual: true, acc_in_stage1: true }
provenance.notes: one warp per case; acc zero-init; ascending-K chain; scale selectors {byte-id,thread-id}={0,0}; scans read window widths via exact cancellation

provenance.target: sm_120 RTX 5090, mma.sync.aligned.m16n8k32.row.col.kind::f8f6f4.f32.e2m1.e2m1.f32, ascending-K chain, no split-K, zero-init acc
provenance.notes: below the exactness bound silicon must equal CANON=NATIVE=BITREF=model2 bitwise (zero rounding events); the boundary116544 suite is the M0.5 parity construction — sum ≡3 (mod 4 quarters) separates RNE (CANON) from RZ (NATIVE v0) by 1 ulp and silicon votes
